collection.title: Rover 200 1984 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Rover 200 Mk1/2/3 1984 to 1999 requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this 200 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
